newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices -April 11.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices -April 11.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker quotes were little changed on Friday but well supported by gains in crude values, tradres said. The 180-cst/380-cst spread remained at a widened $7 per tonne although some sellers said supplies of 180-cst grade were not as tight as in previous days. Most traders saw a slight uptrend for bunker prices. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3571)
